# Establishment log — popol-vuh-023 (image 0072 from line 2, 0073, 0074 to line 21)

Read 2026-11-28 by the routine's own model from source/pages/i0072 (from `Cate puch ta xqui biyh qui bi`, after
`… qui halvachibal quib ta xqui bano.`), all of i0073, and i0074 to `… e vchumilal cah xe vxic.` (about line 21),
in strips of four to five lines at full resolution, with 1.5–2.5× crops of doubtful words, checked word by word
against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines c. 27306–27660, his chapter 14 entire). Pillow in a scratch venv.

Start: `Cate puch ta xqui biyh qui bi` (0072 l.2). End: `… e vchumilal cah xe vxic.` (0074 c. l.21), the end of
Brasseur's chapter 14 and of his second book. The next words, the indented `Vae cut vtiquiric ta xnaohix vinac …`
(0074), begin the making of people (Brasseur's `OXPAH CHI VUH`, his heading, not in the MS) and popol-vuh-024.
parts.json: 024 images set to 0074–0076 (were 0078–0080, which would have left 0074–0077 unread); plan.md updated.
025 (0081–0083) will need the same adjustment by 024's establishing run.

Content: the twins tell all Xibalba their names and their fathers' names and pronounce sentence; Xibalba begs for
mercy; the sentence (no great day for them, no rubber ball game, only pots, griddles and grinding, the creatures of
the thicket; the clear-light children not theirs); what Xibalba was like (not gods of old; owls, makers of evil,
two-faced, painted); Xmucane and the canes that dried and sprouted again; she burns copal and names them Nicah Ha,
Nicah, Cazam Ah, Chatam Vleu; the fathers honoured at Pucbal Chah, Vucub Hunahpu's face restored, only his name
recovered; the twins console them; the twins rise to the sky as sun and moon; the four hundred boys killed by
Zipacna become stars.

Paragraphs: Ximénez's indents at `Chitaa ca bi` (0072 l.5) and `Va cute vviquic` (0073); the others are ours at
the sense joints, following Brasseur's breaks, as 015–022.

## Folios
0072 carries `31` at the top left (31v), 0074 `32` (32v); 0073 = 32r → `fols. 31v–32v`.

## README 5b corrections (recorded in QUESTIONS.md; the drafter's notes open with the MS reading)
- 0073 (lower third), MS `chuvi chata vleu` → `Chatam Vleu` (dropped m; the name is written Chatam Vleu twice in
  the same paragraph; Brasseur Chatam-Uleu).
- 0074 l.5, MS `chi pucba chah` → `Pucbal Chah` (dropped l; written Pucbal Chah on 0072 and 0073; Brasseur
  Pucbal-Chah).

## Supralinear and struck
- 0073, `Pucbal Chah` (Va cute paragraph): an ink blot over the c of `chah`, and `chah` written again above the
  line; printed once.
- 0072 near the foot, `xavi xibal oher iꜩel`: `oher` struck through by Ximénez; left out. Brasseur omits it too.

## Letters and readings decided against or beside Brasseur
- 0072 l.5–6 `xchi ca biyh; xchi ca biyh naipuch`: the MS writes `xchi ca biyh` twice (the second across the line
  break, `xch-|ica byh`); Brasseur has it once. Not treated as a misprint: `naipuch` 'also' reads naturally after a
  first statement ("we shall say ours; we shall say also our fathers' names"). Doubtful.
- `biyh`: MS `byh` with a small mark over the y, as in earlier parts; printed `biyh` (002, 007, 022).
- 0072 `mana nim chi quih`: a q-shaped letter + `uih`; Brasseur `gih` (ꜫ). Printed `quih` as written (as 022
  `mayo quih`). Same for `maui nim qui quih oher` (0072), `quix quihiloxic` (0074; Br. gihiloxic) and `hun cu quih`
  (0074, the sun; the house form is ꜫih). The modern toggle should give q'ij.
- 0072 `ivalaxic chuxic`: the MS letter after `ch` looks like a; Brasseur `ch'uxic`; a/u ambiguous in the hand,
  Brasseur followed. Same for `mavi chu hom` (MS looks `chahom`; Br. `chu hom`). Doubtful.
- 0072 `ruꜭ naipuch`: the g-shaped letter (cuatrillo by the hand); Brasseur's OCR `rug` (= his g, ꜫ). Printed ꜭ by
  the hand; meaning uncertain. Doubtful.
- 0072 `chi i cochibal`: MS `chi ico chibal`; Brasseur `y cochibal`.
- 0072 `x zcaquin chic`: an isolated x stands before `zcaquin` (clearly written, separated by a space); Brasseur
  omits it. Printed as written; probably `xa` abbreviated or a false start. Doubtful.
- 0072 `chi quic holomax` (twice): the first has a raised stroke over the c (`quiḱ`); Brasseur `quiq holomax` both
  times. Printed `quic` as the second and as 010/011.
- 0072 `ahmoquer, chac na vmac`: MS `ahmoquer` (r, not n) at the line end, then `chacna vmac`; Brasseur
  `ahmoquen ch'oc na u mak`. Printed as the image shows; both words doubtful.
- 0072 `licarinac`: the line-end letters `li-` are cramped (could be read ꜭ-); Brasseur `liqarinak`. Doubtful.
- 0072 `xa xrah ꜩa vi`: Brasseur `tza`; the tz ligature.
- 0072 `cabauil`: MS `cabavil` with an inked-over final letter; Brasseur `qabauil`.
- 0073 `e quecail zaquil, ahmoxvach`: MS `zaquilah moxvach` read as `zaquil ahmoxvach` (Brasseur `gekail-zàkiil,
  ahmoxvach`). `quecail` plain qu/c (Br. g).
- 0073 `cacal`: plain c twice (Br. gagal).
- 0073, 0074 `coquic`: q-shaped letter + u (as published `coquic`); Brasseur `c'ogic`.
- 0073 `catit` (×4): written `ca` + a tall looped `tit`; as everywhere.
- 0073 `xu binahzah`: MS `xubinahʒah`; Brasseur `x-u binatizah`. Printed as the image shows (z by Brasseur's
  `z`). Doubtful.
- 0073 `Nicah Ha, Nicah bi choc`: Ximénez underlines `cazamah`, `chatam vleu` and both `nicah` as names.
- 0073 `chi quetax`: Brasseur `chi qu'etax`.
- 0073 `xbe qui vica vi`: MS letter could be read h (`xhe`); Brasseur `x-be`.
- 0073 `xquivic ri`: a small mark above the end of `ri`; ignored.
- 0074 `v Hunahpuil`: MS `vhunahpuil`; Brasseur `u Hunahpuil`.
- 0074 `xe ꜭohe vi`: MS `xegoheui` (g-shaped cuatrillo), as published `ꜭohe vi`.
- 0074 `nicah zac`: an ink blot over the last letter of `za-`; Brasseur `nicah zak`.
- 0074 `ca chacanic`: MS `cachacanic`; Brasseur `ca ch'akanic`. Word division doubtful (ch' + acan 'climb'?).
